model_output.summary: You raised your class's average reading growth from 0.8 to 1.4 grade levels per year over three years. Your recent work also includes leading weekly grade-level meetings and training teachers on a new math curriculum. That combination describes an elementary teacher with grade-level leadership responsibilities. The resume doesn't yet explain which reading practices you used, so a reviewer has limited insight into how you approached that result.
strengths: The 27-student class and the share of English language learners give useful context for your current teaching.
The family literacy night attendance of 140 families shows the reach of an event you coordinated.
Your Washington K-8 certificate and English Language Learner endorsement make your qualifications easy to locate.
gaps: The math curriculum pilot doesn't describe what you tested or how you trained the other teachers, leaving the work behind the pilot unclear.
Your committee service doesn't name a contribution, so its connection to student behavior support is difficult to assess.
The homework club lists attendance and frequency but not the kind of help you provided, making the activity less distinctive.
